method: Team-aggregate reconciliation. Wins, losses, ties, points-for and points-against were derived independently from data/games_1999_2026_nflverse.csv for every team and compared, team by team, with the official nfl.com division standings pages read on the attestation date. No per-game official verification was performed and none is claimed (see flagged item F-11).
redistribution_note: The 64 rows of NFL-sourced standings values used for this comparison were removed from the repository because the NFL.com terms restrict systematic retrieval and reproduction and this project holds no NFL licence (flagged item F-10). This file therefore records only counts, team codes of any mismatch, source URLs and the date.

official_csv_schema.note: If a rights holder places a file with this schema in data/official/, pipeline/verify.py re-runs the comparison locally and sets reproducible_offline = true.
